title: Silicon Operations Manager
description:
Meet Arago and the Aragonians

Arago’s mission is to re-engineer the foundations of computing from first principles.

The explosive growth of AI is pushing the industry to rethink how processors are built. Arago is meeting that challenge with a proprietary technology that fuses optical and CMOS technologies to deliver an order-of-magnitude increase in performance.

Arago is the fastest, and currently the only, company to have built such a processor. It's backed by leading deep-tech investors and some of the most respected figures in semiconductors and computing, including the CEO of Arm, the founder of macOS who worked directly with Steve Jobs at Apple, an Nvidia Fellow, the Head of Optics at Google, and many other industry leaders.

Our work is guided by three clear values: do great things, move with high velocity, and operate as one unit. We work in a demanding environment where constant learning, ownership, and execution are expected, and where exceptional people have the opportunity to do their life’s work.

 

What you’ll do

Arago designs its own SoCs. As Silicon Operations Manager, you will own everything after design, from foundry handoff to volume production. You pick up the chip once front-end and physical design are done, and you are accountable for getting working parts in volume. That means managing the foundry, OSAT partners, and test house; co-designing the package; driving qualification and yield ramp; and owning cost, schedule, and supplier relationships.

This is not a coordinator role. You are the technical owner of the path from tapeout to shipped product.

Required Skills and Experience

  • 7+ years in semiconductor back-end / NPI, with at least one chip taken to production in a fabless context as the main contact with OSATs and foundries.

  • Direct experience managing OSATs and foundries (e.g. TSMC, GF, Samsung, Amkor, ASE).

  • Solid knowledge of advanced packaging: flip-chip, FCBGA, substrates, and package/die co-design.

  • ATE test and wafer sort experience, plus solid understanding of DFT handoff.

  • Knowledge of JEDEC qualification and reliability standards.

  • Engineering degree or PhD in microelectronics, materials, or electrical engineering.

  • Language: English at a proficient level.

Responsibilities

  • Own the tapeout-to-production flow: GDS handoff, masks, wafer starts, MPW vs. full-mask planning.

  • Select the package with OSATs and co-design it, flip-chip/BGA, substrate, bump and ball maps, thermal, SI/PI, in collaboration with the design team.

  • Drive wafer sort and final test: probe cards, ATE program bring-up, DFT pattern handoff.

  • Run qualification and reliability: JEDEC standards including HTOL, ESD, MSL, TC and others.

  • Lead yield analysis, failure analysis and corrective actions.

  • Manage suppliers, NRE and unit cost; contribute to supplier negotiations.

  • Plan the ramp to volume, manage supply and logistics, and maintain production documentation.

Nice to have

  • 2.5D/3D, chiplets, interposers (CoWoS, InFO).

  • Package design and simulation tools (Cadence APD/SiP, Ansys).

  • Statistical yield tools (JMP, Exensio/PDF).

  • Startup or scale-up experience; budget and contract ownership.

Pay and benefits

  • Competitive cash compensation, with final package based on location, experience, and the pay of team members in similar positions.

  • Meaningful stock option plan offered (included in the majority of full time offers).

  • Healthcare coverage (including family-friendly options), pension contributions, professional development support, and 25 days of PTO, in addition to public holidays.

  • Ownership of a key technical domain, with significant vertical and/or horizontal growth opportunities, based on performance and individual drive.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of AI at Arago.

title: INTESCIA - DATA SCIENTIST (H/F) - Stage MASTER II (6 mois)
description:
DATA SCIENTIST (H/F)

STAGE MASTER II - 6 mois

Rejoignez le Groupe INTESCIA, leader de la Business Intelligence en Europe !

Qui sommes-nous ?
Chez Intescia, nous transformons la donnée en levier de croissance. Leader européen de la Data Intelligence, nous opérons le portefeuille de données et de solutions le plus complet du marché pour aider les entreprises à détecter plus vite les opportunités, mieux comprendre leurs marchés et décider avec impact.

Présents en France, en Espagne, en Italie et en Belgique, nous réalisons plus de 75 M€ de chiffre d'affaires et figurons parmi les 50 plus grands acteurs de l'industrie du logiciel et de la data en France. Au quotidien, des milliers d'entreprises s'appuient sur nos solutions pour accélérer leur business.

Contexte du stage

Les LLMs (Large Language Model) sont des outils efficaces, rapides à prendre en main et généralistes, ce qui en fait un choix technique facile pour une grande partie des projets de traitement du langage naturel. Ils ont supplanté une partie des algorithmes de Data Science plus « classiques ».

Cependant, ils ne sont pas exempts de défauts. Ils sont extrêmement coûteux en énergie, coûteux en eaux, coûteux financièrement et ils nécessitent d’importants investissements (création de Data Centers) pour être mis en place.

Dans une volonté de contrôle des données produites et utilisées par l’entreprise (et plus largement de toutes données privées), il est important de garantir que les données traitées soient protégées, ce que l’usage de certains LLMs ne garantit pas. Nous venons par ailleurs de vivre en France, une série de canicules les plus importantes de ces dernières décennies, avec des records de température dans de nombreuses villes françaises. Il est nécessaire de prendre des actions pour aller vers des technologies plus sobres en énergie.

Par ailleurs, le monde de l’IA connaît une période d’incertitude, avec une course effrénée vers des modèles généralistes de plus en plus gros et de plus en plus gloutons en espace comme en énergie. Dans ce contexte, nous souhaitons nous orienter vers des méthodes plus « frugales ». Nous souhaitons ainsi de préférence adapter de petits modèles à des tâches très précises, qui ont l’avantage d’être plus parcimonieux. Un axe principal du travail sera donc de construire des modèles dont la création sera standardisée, avec un minimum de paramétrage à effectuer, et moins de labellisation manuelle à fournir. Nous souhaitons proposer une méthode qui soit la plus générique possible (voir en appui sur les approches MCP/ADK). Les questions clés sont de déterminer s’il est possible de répertorier, créer et tester des modèles pour nos cas d’usages, et de quantifier le gain énergétique de ces modèles en comparaison avec d’anciennes techniques présentes dans le groupe.

Votre mission :

L’objectif principal du stage est de produire un benchmark et une analyse complète des outils de Data Science proposés par Explore. Ce travail sera complété par une bibliographie des domaines dans lesquels s’inscrivent les solutions proposées.

Enfin, ce stage est prévu pour aboutir à une thèse CIFRE, et l’étudiant.e sera encouragé.e à participer à la rédaction du sujet de thèse.

Des déplacements ponctuels au L3i de La Rochelle seront également prévus.

Les livrables attendus pour ce stage sont :

• Un état de l’art des approches existantes et de l’état des technologies utilisées par Explore

• Un benchmark de ces approches sur des données de l’entreprise

• Une publication scientifique résumant tout ce travail.

 

Ce stage sera rémunéré à hauteur de 1000€ mensuel.

Informations importantes

ð  Ce stage sera suivi d’une thèse CIFRE d’une durée de trois ans, financée par le groupe Intescia ;

ð  Ce stage est co-encadré entre le laboratoire L3i de La Rochelle Université et Explore, filiale du groupe Intescia.

 

Le L3i (Laboratoire Informatique, Image et Interaction) est le laboratoire de recherche en informatique de La Rochelle Université, créé en 1993 et labellisé Équipe de Recherche Technologique. Il rassemble une centaine de membres, dont 32 enseignants-chercheurs, une trentaine de doctorants et 7 personnels permanents de soutien à la recherche, répartis en trois équipes : « Dynamique des systèmes et adaptativité », « Images et contenus », et « Modèles et connaissances ». Il dispose d’une expertise reconnue internationalement autour de l’analyse et de la compréhension de documents, notamment administratifs.

 

Les encadrants du côté laboratoire sont : Antoine Doucet et Mickael Coustaty.

Du côté Explore : Julie Queiros, avec une participation ponctuelle du manager de l’équipe, Steven Hellec.

  

• Les étapes du recrutement seront les suivantes :

  •    1er entretien avec Julie QUEIROS, DATA SCIENTIST chez Explore, accompagnée du personnel encadrant du laboratoire ;

  •    2ème entretien et restitution de cas pratique avec Julie, accompagnée de son N+1 Steven HELLEC, ainsi que des encadrants du laboratoire ;

  •    3ème et dernier entretien avec l’équipe RH, pour tout formaliser.

Le profil que nous recherchons

  •       Étudiant·e de Master 2 dans les domaines suivants : Informatique / Mathématiques Information / Statistiques / Traitement du langage naturel / Data Science. 

  •       Appétence à la recherche 

  •       Connaissances en : Python, SQL, Méthodes de NLP  

  •       Maîtrise de l’anglais 

  •       Qualités de rédaction, d’analyse et d’autonomie appréciées.

Ce que nous vous offrons :

Life at UiPath

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?

Your mission

As a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer, you will own the delivery of scoped customer implementations and help turn real-world business needs into production-grade agentic automation solutions. You’ll partner closely with customer stakeholders and internal teams to design, build, integrate, and iterate on AI-enabled workflows, balancing speed, reliability, and maintainability. You’ll contribute practical field insights back to the organization, helping refine solution patterns, reusable assets, and implementation playbooks.

Unlike traditional software engineers who build a single product for many customers, FDEs ship tailored solutions directly in customer environments, making the platform real for specific business processes and systems. You’ll operate with increasing independence, drive execution on well-defined workstreams, and collaborate with senior FDEs and product teams to align with broader technical direction.

 

What you'll do at UiPath

  • Design and build AI-driven workflows, agents, and automations, aligned with UiPath's architecture and platform standards without requiring regular guidance.

  • Build AI Agents using UiPath technologies, including Maestro or Agent Builder

  • Apply practical prompt engineering skills to reliably guide agent behavior and understand model tradeoffs (capability, latency, cost) when selecting LLM providers for customer use cases.

  • Extend platform functionality using APIs, SDKs, and connectors to address unique customer requirements.

  • Debug across systems including AI inference, data pipelines, orchestration layers, and integration points, resolving most issues independently.

  • Contribute to internal libraries, reusable components, or frameworks that enhance consistency across customer deployments.

  • Anticipate delivery risks and communicate blockers, delays, and scope issues proactively to teammates and stakeholders.

  • Use telemetry, insights, and traces to identify optimization opportunities and failure patterns independently.

 

What you'll bring to the team

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience (or equivalent) delivering production software.

  • Strong programming skills in Python and/or TypeScript (or similar modern languages).

  • Experience building and shipping integrations using APIs and working with cloud services or enterprise systems.

  • Comfort operating in customer-facing environments with strong written and verbal communication.

  • Ability to independently drive scoped projects, manage risks, and deliver against deadlines.

  • Willingness to travel to customer sites as needed.

 

Our core principles

  • Customer Centric: Stay close to customer users and stakeholders; anchor decisions in outcomes, adoption, and long-term success.

  • Breaking Silos: Collaborate across Engineering, Product, Customer Success, and customer teams to unblock delivery and align on the right solution.

  • Improving Agility: Prototype, test, ship, observe, and iterate—treat deployments and feedback loops as the fastest way to learn.

  • Dealing with Ambiguity: Make progress with incomplete information; clarify requirements through discovery, iteration, and pragmatic tradeoffs.

  • Building Focus: Prioritize the highest-impact workstreams, manage scope actively, and deliver durable solutions that customers can run and evolve.

Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes—and passion can’t be learned.

Many of our roles allow for flexibility in when and where work gets done. Depending on the needs of the business and the role, the number of hybrid, office-based, and remote workers will vary from team to team. Applications are assessed on a rolling basis and there is no fixed deadline for this requisition. The application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or may close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected.

We value a range of diverse backgrounds, experiences and ideas. We pride ourselves on our diversity and inclusive workplace that provides equal opportunities to all persons regardless of age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, and expression, national origin, disability, neurodiversity, military and/or veteran status, or any other protected classes. Additionally, UiPath provides reasonable accommodations for candidates on request and respects applicants' privacy rights. To review these and other legal disclosures, visit our privacy policy.

title: Senior/Staff AI Engineer - Python (x/f/m)
description:
Set a new pulse for healthcare!

We are looking for a Senior or Senior/Staff AI Engineer to join our tech team.

Your mission will be to build production-grade agentic systems at the heart of Doctolib's AI strategy. You will work in a feature team developing LLM-powered products that improve the daily lives of health professionals and patients, contributing to Doctolib's ambition to reinvent healthcare through AI.

Working in the tech team at Doctolib means building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients.

What you'll do

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Design, ship, and operate production-grade agentic LLM systems that improve health professionals' and patients' experience across Doctolib's products

  • Validate hypotheses with offline evaluation datasets and A/B tests on real traffic

  • Partner with machine learning teams to design evaluation pipelines, safety guardrails, and performance metrics for AI systems at scale

  • Build and maintain core agentic capabilities: memory, reasoning orchestration, and tool adapters, with strong observability, fallback mechanisms, and fail-safe behaviors

  • Own performance monitoring, SLO/SLI, security posture, and privacy by design across the systems you build

Life at Doctolib Tech

  • Our solutions are built on a single fully cloud-native platform that supports web and mobile app interfaces, multiple languages, and is adapted to country and healthcare specialty requirements.

  • Our stack is composed of Rails, TypeScript, Java, Python, Kotlin, Swift, and React Native.

  • We leverage AI ethically across our products to empower patients and health professionals. Discover our AI vision here.

  • We also invest in open, applied AI research. Our DoctoBERT project introduces open-source medical language models trained for French clinical text, with applications in named entity recognition, classification, and retrieval. Read the DoctoBERT practical guide to learn more about how we bring deep AI research into practical healthcare applications.

Want to learn more about our tech culture and environment? Visit the Doctolib Tech site.

  • Have 6+ years of experience as a software engineer, with significant Python experience

  • Apply software engineering best practices as standard: automated testing, CI/CD, and DevOps ("you build it, you run it")

  • Are product-oriented and comfortable guiding your team through tradeoffs between business needs and technical constraints

  • Care about code quality and have a rigorous testing culture; enjoy growing the people around you through pair programming and mentoring

  • Are fluent in English, written and spoken

It would be fantastic if you:

  • Lunch vouchers (Swile card) worth €8.50 per working day, with €4.50 covered by Doctolib

  • A subsidy from the work council to refund part of the membership to a sport club or a creative class

  • 50% reimbursement of your public transport subscription

  • Enrollment in Doctolib's long-term employee value sharing plan called DoctoGrowth

  • ParentCare Program: Enjoy full salary coverage (100%) during your first month of birth leave, and 75% during the second, covered by Doctolib

  • For caregivers and workers with disabilities, a package including an adaptation of the remote policy, extra days off for medical reasons, and psychological support

The interview process

  • Agentic AI System Design Interview

We want your experience to be clear, respectful, and transparent. Learn more about our hiring process on our candidate experience page.

Job details

title: AI Engineer Intern (x/f/m) - Paris
description:

We are looking for an AI Engineer Intern to join our Tech team and contribute to the development of AI-powered features at Doctolib.

You will work closely with experienced AI and software engineers to explore, prototype, evaluate, and improve AI-based solutions. This internship will give you the opportunity to gain practical experience across the different stages of an AI product, from experimentation to integration into a production environment.

title: Lead Architect – Digital Assets & Tokenization
description:
Location: Paris, France (4 days onsite per week)

Employment Type: Permanent, Full-time

Salary: €100,000 – €120,000 gross/year

About the Opportunity

We are partnering with a leading European financial market infrastructure group to build a new Digital Assets division, focused on tokenisation and Distributed Ledger Technology (DLT).

The mission is to develop next-generation financial infrastructure, launch innovative digital asset products for institutional and retail clients, and bridge traditional finance (TradFi) with decentralised finance (DeFi).

This is a unique founding-style leadership opportunity within an established, highly regulated financial institution. You will have the opportunity to shape the technical vision, own the architecture, and build foundational technology from the ground up.

The Mission

You will lead the architecture of the organisation's first tokenised financial products, covering two major initiatives:

  • Tokenised Securities Platform: Building an issuance, trading and settlement platform for equities, ETFs and bonds, featuring 24/7 trading, fractional ownership and on-chain Delivery-versus-Payment (DvP) settlement.
  • Tokenised Collateral Management Platform: Enabling real-time repo transactions, CCP margin eligibility and DeFi distribution of government bonds through regulated lending environments.

Your responsibility is to translate these strategic initiatives into secure, scalable and auditable technical architectures.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end architecture for digital asset solutions, integrating DLT with traditional financial market infrastructure, including trading, clearing, settlement, custody and CSD.
  • Design cross-chain architectures across permissioned networks (Hyperledger Besu, Canton Network) and public blockchains (Ethereum/L2).
  • Define on-chain compliance frameworks, including ERC-3643/T-REX token standards, KYC-whitelisted wallets, AML screening and transaction reporting.
  • Architect institutional custody and key management solutions using MPC technologies such as Fireblocks and Taurus.
  • Establish engineering standards covering code quality, architecture reviews, testing and secure-by-design development.
  • Lead threat modelling and security architecture for high-value financial systems.
  • Drive build-versus-buy decisions across blockchain infrastructure, custody and audit solutions.
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Legal, Regulatory, Clearing and CSD stakeholders.
  • Remain hands-on with critical technical components and high-risk incidents.
  • Build and develop the engineering team as the platform transitions from development to production.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of experience in Solution Architecture, including at least 3 years working on DLT or blockchain projects.
  • Strong expertise in distributed systems and blockchain architecture.
  • Hands-on experience with EVM and permissioned blockchain networks such as Canton or Hyperledger Besu.
  • Knowledge of regulated security token standards, particularly ERC-3643/T-REX or equivalent.
  • Strong understanding of smart contract security, cross-chain risks and on-chain compliance.
  • Experience designing secure, highly available financial systems operating 24/7.
  • Working knowledge of capital markets infrastructure, including DvP, CSD, CCP and settlement processes.
  • Strong leadership skills with a player-coach mindset.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field.

AI Engineering Skills (Required)

  • Experience defining AI-augmented software development workflows using coding assistants, smart contract scaffolding and AI-generated test suites.
  • Ability to establish governance and security guardrails for AI-assisted code, including code reviews, secret management and licence/provenance checks.
  • Experience evaluating AI development tools and identifying practical productivity improvements.
  • Understanding of AI-powered product capabilities such as anomaly detection and operational triage, including associated risk controls.

Why Join?

  • Take ownership of the architecture for a major digital asset infrastructure initiative.
  • Build innovative tokenisation products at the intersection of TradFi and DeFi.
  • Work within an established European financial institution while enjoying the autonomy of a zero-to-one project.

Créée en 2016, Theodo Data & AI est l'entité Data et IA de Theodo. Notre ambition est d'accompagner nos clients dans la conception et le déploiement de leur stratégie data ainsi que la recherche et le développement de solutions d’intelligence artificielle à l’état de l’art.

title: Product Safety & Certification Engineer
description:
About EH Energy Engineering

EH Energy is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product delivers a significantly more compact fuel cell system with high power density and lower production costs. In response to the challenges of climate change and the global shift toward decentralized energy, EH Energy provides high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To support our rapid growth and bring our systems to global markets, we are seeking a Certification Engineer. In this critical role, you will take full ownership of our product compliance roadmap, bridging the gap between innovative engineering and strict global regulations. You will lead hazard and risk assessments, define certification strategies across international markets (EU, North America, marine), and interface directly with notified bodies and classification societies to ensure our fuel cell systems are safe, fully compliant, and market-ready.

This role requires a full-time, on-site presence at our office in Nyon, Switzerland. We are unable to offer remote or hybrid arrangements, so candidates should be based locally or prepared to relocate.

 

Key responsibilities

Certification strategy and project management

  • Identify applicable directives, regulations, harmonised standards and class rules early in the development cycle and translate them into design requirements (EU, North America, marine)

  • Select and manage notified bodies, NRTLs, classification societies and test laboratories, own budgets, schedules and contracts for certification work

  • Plan and witness type tests, factory acceptance tests (FAT) and site acceptance tests (SAT)

Safety engineering and risk analysis

  • Lead risk assessments to ISO 12100 and hazard studies (HAZID, HAZOP to IEC 61882)

  • Lead design and process FMEA (IEC 60812) for stacks, balance of plant, containers and fuel processing

  • Run explosion-protection assessments: hazardous area classification (IEC 60079-10-1), ventilation and gas detection concepts, and equipment selection

  • Specify and verify safety functions to ISO 13849 (PL) and IEC 61508, including safety requirement specifications and validation reports

Compliance and technical documentation

  • Compile and maintain technical construction files, CE Declarations of Conformity, type-approval dossiers and certification reports

  • Write and review user, installation, operation and maintenance manuals, safety instructions and labelling

  • Maintain the standards register and assess the impact of new or revised standards

  • Manage certification change control: assess design changes for impact on existing certificates

Collaboration and continuous improvement

  • Act as the internal authority on certification scope: ensure in-service conformity of series production with certified designs, and support procurement and supply chain on material and packaging compliance (e.g. RoHS, packaging regulations).

  • Support design reviews and supplier qualification, including component certificates (ATEX, PED, electrical)

Standards and regulatory scope

The role covers, but is not limited to, the frameworks below. Working knowledge of most is expected; deep expertise in several is required

  • IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1:2021, ISO 16110-1 and Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230

     

Required qualifications

  • Master’s or bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, chemical, process or safety engineering, or equivalent

  • 5+ years in product certification, compliance or safety engineering for complex electromechanical or process equipment (energy, gas, process, machinery or marine)

  • Direct experience with hydrogen or fuel cell systems and the IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1 or ISO 16110

  • Proven track record of taking products through CE marking and third-party certification with notified bodies or NRTLs

  • Hands-on experience leading FMEA, HAZOP and risk assessments, and documenting them to auditor standard

  • Solid knowledge of ATEX / IECEx, hazardous area classification and explosion-protection concepts

  • Experience specifying and validating safety functions to ISO 13849 and/or IEC 61508

  • Excellent technical writing: clear, structured, audit-ready technical files and manuals

  • Fluent English, written and spoken

     

Preferred qualifications and personal profile

Nice to have

  • Marine type approval with a classification society (DNV, LR, BV, ABS) or IGF Code projects

  • Experience with fuel processing, reformers or fire equipment, and with pressure equipment under PED

  • Certified functional safety qualification or ATEX/IECEx competence certification

  • Familiarity with North American codes (NEC, NFPA) and UL/CSA certification

Personal profile

  • Rigorous and structured, with a strong safety mindset and an eye for detail

  • Pragmatic: finds compliant solutions that keep development moving

  • Confident communicator with engineers, auditors, authorities and customers

  • Self-driven in a fast-growing, scale-up environment; comfortable owning topics end to end

     

Start date: Immediately

title: Data Engineer Intern
description:
Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots.

Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment.


Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry.


About the role
The MLOps team at Gravis builds the data flow that turns raw recordings from our autonomous earthmoving machines (LiDAR point clouds, camera images, GNSS positions and hydraulic signals) into clean, searchable, training-ready datasets for our autonomy models.
 
As an intern, you will learn how data moves through Gravis today, explore data pipeline tools and try the most promising ones on real fleet data, and have the opportunity to help build a pipeline that runs in production on our GPU clusters and is used by our ML and robotics engineers every day, with direct mentorship from senior engineers.
 
We are looking for a motivated student or recent graduate with a background in computer science, data science or a related field and a solid foundation in Python and data processing, available to start in early 2027. 

What you will do

Data pipeline

  • Get to know how data is collected, stored, processed and labelled at Gravis today, map the current data flows, and suggest ways to improve them

  • Explore the data pipeline and orchestration tools available today (e.g., Dagster, Flyte, Argo Workflows, Airflow, Ray Data) and compare them against our requirements: data volume, multimodal sensor data, CPU and GPU processing steps, reproducibility and ease of use

  • Help build small prototypes of the most promising options and test them on real fleet data, from raw machine recordings to training-ready datasets

  • Work with our infrastructure team to set up the chosen pipeline on Kubernetes, so that it runs reliably on our on-premise and cloud clusters

  • Help add data versioning, quality checks, lineage and monitoring, so that engineers can trust every dataset and trace where it came from

    • Collaboration and sharing

  • Write up the trade-offs and present your recommendation to the team

  • Document the pipeline and help ML and robotics engineers start using it


    • What we're looking for

    We recognise that excellent candidates come from diverse backgrounds with varied combinations of skills. If you meet most of the core qualifications below, we encourage you to apply.

    Core qualifications

  • Currently enrolled in, or recently graduated from, a Master's programme in Computer Science, Data Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field in a Swiss university 

  • Solid Python skills and hands-on experience with data pipelines or data-heavy applications, from coursework, a thesis, side projects or a previous internship

  • Good working knowledge of data processing fundamentals: batch and streaming processing, columnar file formats (e.g., Parquet), and SQL databases

  • Familiarity with Docker and working in a Linux environment

  • Comfortable with open-ended problems where the answer is not known yet, and able to compare technical options and explain your reasoning, both in writing and in front of a team

    • Nice to have

  • Experience with a workflow orchestrator (e.g., Dagster, Airflow, Prefect, Flyte, Argo Workflows)

  • Experience with distributed data processing frameworks (e.g., Ray, Spark, Dask)

  • Experience with Kubernetes

  • Experience working with robotics or sensor data (point clouds, camera streams, time-series data) and formats such as ROS bags or MCAP

  • Experience with data versioning or dataset management tools (e.g., DVC, lakeFS)


    • This role is a great fit if…

  • You are eager to apply your academic knowledge to real-world problems, and to see your work having an impact on actual machines

  • You want to contribute to a foundational data pipeline that helps our machines improve faster

  • You thrive in a hands-on environment where you learn new tools by trying them out on real data

  • You are curious about machine learning and about how training datasets are built

  • You value a collaborative culture built on thoughtful design, creative problem-solving, mutual respect, and pragmatism

About Us

About the Role

We are developing advanced autonomous systems that need to fly close to the ground, over varied terrain and through cluttered environments such as forests and built-up areas, where there is very little margin for error.

Even a carefully prepared flight plan must be backed by onboard sensing, ready to react to terrain variations and unexpected obstacles. We are building this capability and exploring hybrid approaches that combine planning and real-time reaction.

Your mission

The goal of this internship is to explore, develop and evaluate terrain-following and collision-avoidance methods based primarily on onboard sensors, enabling safe low-altitude flight.

Responsibilities

  • Literature review: Conduct a comprehensive review of existing terrain-following approaches and obstacle-avoidance

  • Algorithm Implementation: Develop and implement various algorithms based on the literature review and project requirements using simulated and real-world flight data.

  • Performance evaluation: Assess and compare the performance, safety margins and computational overhead of the developed algorithms.

  • Embedded constraints: Ensure the solutions are compatible with real-time execution and the computational limits of onboard hardware.

  • Documentation: Document all work performed, including methodologies, results, and conclusions.

  • Flight Tests Participation: Actively participate in flight test sessions to gather real-world data and validate the effectiveness of the developed algorithms in operational conditions. Contribute to real-time deployment.

Candidates Requirements

  • Educational Background: A strong academic record in robotics, aerospace engineering, automatic control, applied mathematics or a related field. Knowledge of perception, guidance or motion planning is a strong plus.

  • Technical Skills: Solid foundation in sensor fusion and/or guidance and control. Experience with lidar or vision processing, terrain data or drones is a major plus.

  • Mindset: You are curious to learn, autonomous and able to take initiative.

title: Revenue Operations Manager
description:
About Tebi

Tebi is building a modern connected hospitality operating system that helps entrepreneurs run their business more intelligently and smoothly. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen, inventory, and payments (as well as all the data that powers it) helping to automate work, streamline operations, and give hospitality owners the clarity and time they need to focus on what matters the most: creating great guest experiences.

Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is build in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Spain, Italy, Denmark, Germany, Finland, and Ireland.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Revenue Operations Manager to build and run the systems behind Tebi’s revenue engine, from how we find and win merchants to how we onboard, retain and grow them across seven European markets.

You’ll apply skills like building enrichment flows, tracking buying signals, setting up outbound and automating workflows in HubSpot and the tools around it across the customer lifecycle, from lead enrichment and outbound to onboarding handover, customer health and expansion. You’ll report to our RevOps Lead and work closely with Sales, Marketing, Onboarding, Account Management and the Data team.

This is a hands-on role where speed matters. You’ll build with Clay, HubSpot, n8n, APIs, webhooks and AI, and take every idea from first experiment to a system the whole go-to-market team relies on. You understand what drives revenue, so you know what is worth building, and you work in short loops: ship fast, measure, learn and adapt quickly.

What You’ll Do

Build the acquisition engine

  • Build enrichment flows, ideal customer profile scoring and lead routing that turn raw leads into clear next actions for reps in HubSpot.

  • Design and automate signal tracking across the funnel, including walk-in activity in emerging markets not yet visible in HubSpot.

  • Build outbound plays and sequencing systems for sales-led and PLG motions, and run experiments to learn how best to reach customers.

  • Prototype and improve an AI outbound assistant that saves reps time, with a human in the loop.

Build the processes and automation behind onboarding, retention and expansion

  • Design and automate the Sales-to-Onboarding handover process across our toolstack, replacing manual steps and setting milestones, ownership and service levels from signed to live, with alerts when a merchant stalls.

  • Set up the retention signals and risk alerts that matter, each routed to a clear action and owner.

  • Design the expansion framework from scratch for sales-led (Account Manager-led) and PLG (automated, in-product or lifecycle) upsell, and build the plays, sequences and automation behind it in our toolstack.

  • Measure and refine these processes against pipeline, retention and expansion outcomes, and talk to reps, Account Managers and merchants about their pain points to turn what you learn into better workflows and systems.

  • Build and maintain the integrations across our toolstack, including HubSpot, BigQuery and the enrichment and outbound tools, and document system logic so it scales with the team.

What You’ll Need

  • Around 3 or more years of relevant experience in RevOps, sales operations or customer success operations, or an equivalent role in B2B SaaS.

  • Hands-on experience building enrichment flows, signal tracking and outbound systems.

  • Experience in high-velocity SaaS or an agency.

  • Good knowledge of Clay and other GTM tools, such as n8n, Make, Apollo, Instantly or similar, and comfort working with APIs and webhooks.

  • Hands-on HubSpot experience beyond admin work: workflows, lifecycle stages, properties and reporting.

  • Proven experience building workflows, sequences and lifecycle automation end to end, for both sales-led and PLG motions.

  • Experience designing and automating onboarding or handover processes, and defining health, risk and expansion signals that turn into alerts and actions.

  • The ability to understand customer pain points and translate them into plays and systems that people use in their daily work.

  • Day-to-day experience building with AI, with real workflows, agents or automations you have shipped, and a habit of testing new tools to see what works.

  • An “everything is figureoutable” mindset: you start from a blank page, ship a first version fast, learn from what happens and adapt quickly.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with BigQuery, Dataform, Metabase or comparable analytics tools.

  • B2B SaaS experience in a growing company where systems and processes are still being built, ideally across multiple countries or markets.

  • Familiarity with hospitality technology, POS, payments or merchant services.

  • Experience applying AI to outbound and customer success workflows, with attention to data quality and human review.

We’re looking for an operator who thinks commercially, builds with AI every day and moves fast: building from scratch, learning by testing, and helping every merchant get live quickly and grow with us.

If this speaks to you we can be the right fit. Learn more about how we work from our Recipe here: https://www.tebi.com/gb/careers.

Benefits:

  • Start-up Equity

  • Competitive Salary

  • Lunch in the office

  • Flexible time off

  • Team events

What is Restaurant Software?

Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don’t. It’s a mess, and we are fixing it.

From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it’s a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy.

How we use AI at Tebi

We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed.

At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improve but doesn’t make the last call. If there's a smarter way to do something, we want to find it.

The role is based at our office in Amsterdam and involves regular international travel to customers, partners and sea trials.

This is a player-coach role. In the first months you are hands-on in our most important opportunities: running technical discovery with navies, coast guards, port authorities and system integrators, translating operational requirements (from harbour protection to seabed and subsea infrastructure surveillance) into system architectures, leading demonstrations and sea trials, and being the technical counterpart the customer trusts.

In parallel you lay the foundations: a clear engagement model with Sales and Bid Management, a repeatable technical sales process and reusable solution and demo assets. Within 12 months you have hired and developed a team of solution architects across our key regions, and your focus has shifted from doing the work to multiplying it.

Key responsibilities:

  • Own the technical win on priority opportunities: lead discovery, solution design, demonstrations and sea trials together with the responsible Sales Director.

  • Build the pre-sales function: define the structure and role profiles, and recruit, onboard and develop solution architects aligned with our regional sales structure.

  • Design the engagement model with Sales and Bid Management, from qualification to technical win and hand-over to project delivery.

  • Develop scalable assets, such as reference architectures, demo set-ups, technical tender content and a knowledge base, so new engineers are productive in weeks, not months.

  • Define and report pre-sales metrics such as coverage, technical win rate and trial conversion in our CRM, and translate customer requirements into input for Product Management and R&D.

  • Collaborate with Sales Directors, Bid Management, Product Management and R&D to win and deliver complex, multi-year naval and underwater security programmes.

  • Contribute to continuous improvement of our technical sales processes, tools and automation.

What we offer:

  • Join one of Europe's fastest-growing deep-tech scale-ups.

  • Real impact: your work directly shapes our growth and success.

  • A great team in an international organisation with colleagues from more than twenty nationalities.

  • A competitive salary and benefits package.

  • 30 days of holiday per year.

  • Fresh team lunches five times a week, plus regular team activities and company events.


Requirements:

  • Master's degree in Applied Physics, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Photonics or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.

  • 8+ years of experience in pre-sales, solutions, application or systems engineering for complex technical systems, including 3+ years leading or building a customer-facing technical team in a fast-growing environment.

  • A broad technical engineering background and proven experience in long-cycle, complex B2B or B2G sales, translating customer requirements into technical solutions.

  • Willingness to travel internationally, including to customer sites and sea trials.

  • Excellent command of English, written and spoken.

  • Strong communication skills and a collaborative, hands-on mindset.

Nice to have:

  • Knowledge of underwater acoustic sensing, sonar and signal processing; domain knowledge can be developed on the job.

  • Experience with tender-driven sales to navies or other defence and security customers.

  • Experience in fiber optic sensing, anti-submarine warfare, seabed surveillance or protection of critical undersea infrastructure such as cables and pipelines.

  • Experience with export control regimes (EU dual-use, ITAR) and defence procurement requirements such as industrial participation.

  • Knowledge of Dutch, German, French or another European language.

As you will be working with clients in the defence and security sectors, obtaining a Certificate of No Objection issued by the AIVD (Dutch General Intelligence and Security Service) is mandatory. This means you will need to undergo a security screening. For more information, please refer to details on security screening.

description:

You'll take full commercial ownership of your pipeline, combining inbound and outbound sales and managing more complex opportunities with businesses with annual revenue of up to €12M.

  • Maintain accurate sales forecasts, manage a healthy pipeline and actively share your commercial knowledge with the team.

What you will bring

  • Ideally 3+ years of B2B technology sales experience, or at least 2 years of highly relevant experience in payments or fintech.

  • Strong full-cycle sales experience, with the ability to independently manage larger customers and more complex deals.

  • Well-developed consultative selling, negotiation and stakeholder management skills.

  • Strong market understanding, commercial judgement, pipeline management and forecasting skills.

  • Native-level Dutch.

  • Curiosity about technology and the practical application of AI in sales.

  • A hungry, humble and smart mindset. You're ambitious, hands-on, self-aware and confident in taking ownership, while remaining open to feedback and continuous learning.

Experience in fintech, payments or the payment service provider (PSP) ecosystem is a strong advantage, but not a requirement.

Grow your way

At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms.

You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step.

No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way.

 

Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy

If you're excited by the idea of building what's next, for yourself and for thousands of businesses across Europe, we'd love to hear from you. Apply with your CV (in English) using the form below.

We believe in Always Be Shipping, and AI brings that philosophy to life across every team, every role, every day

AI is core to how we build. It helps us move faster, simplify work and make smarter decisions, creating real impact for the businesses we serve. We're looking for people who are excited to use AI to shape the future of finance with us.

description:
Opening

Details

Preferred starting date: ASAP

Weekly availability: full-time (5 days/week)

Period: 6 months


About the company

Fiducial is a young but fast-growing deep-tech start-up with big ambitions at the frontier of autonomy, perception, and defence. Our core expertise lies in 3D vision and graphics technologies which we deploy in a dual-use context for inspection and defence. This role will initially focus mainly on the defence context where we are developing software for advanced on-board UAV situational awareness in military applications. Our solutions are aimed to operate with low-cost and widely available sensors and compute. From there, we plan to develop a line-up of interconnected solutions to safeguard European safety.

Our team consists of engineers that are passionate about the technology and solutions they develop. The only time most of us are not thinking about the technology is when we are asleep, and sometimes even then. Our team members have a background in different fields such as Aerospace Engineering, Computational Science and Engineering, Robotics, and Computer Graphics. Our office is located in the Aerospace Innovation Hub, a start-up hub located on the TU Delft campus in the faculty of Aerospace Engineering.

We work closely with top-tier partners, ranging from government agencies and prime contractors to academic research institutes and other start-ups. Our projects span from large tender orders in collaboration with partners, low TRL research with government agencies, to direct collaboration with military units. Whether through formal R&D programs or rapid prototyping tracks, we operate at the intersection of innovation and deployment.


Your role

You will work in our team of experienced 3D computer graphics engineers, 3D vision engineers, and robotics engineers. You will not just work on some unimportant side project, but you might actually build key parts of solutions that will be used by our customers and partners. At Fiducial, graphics is not just about pretty pictures: our rendering, simulation, and GPU pipelines sit directly at the heart of our perception and autonomy systems. Activities include:

  • Building physically-based and multi-spectral rendering and simulation pipelines (e.g. EO and thermal/IR camera simulation) to generate realistic synthetic imagery and test perception algorithms across environments and conditions

  • Developing real-time 3D visualization and flight-analysis tools for inspecting reconstructed 3D flight paths, live sensor data, multi-camera detections, and point clouds

  • Working on real-time 3D reconstruction and novel rendering representations such as Gaussian splatting and multi-camera / LiDAR point-cloud mapping

  • Building real-time terrain and satellite rendering pipelines that run directly in the loop with our visual positioning and navigation algorithms

  • Writing and optimizing GPU compute and rendering workloads (shaders, CUDA, and low-level graphics APIs) to run efficiently on both desktop and low-cost embedded hardware

What we expect from you

  • Experience with real-time software development such as game, rendering, simulation, or embedded development

  • Solid grasp of 3D computer graphics fundamentals (rendering pipelines, 3D math and transforms, shaders, ray/path tracing, or rasterization)

  • Experience with graphics or GPU compute APIs (such as OpenGL, Vulkan, WebGPU/WGSL, DirectX, or CUDA)

  • Experience with 3D scene representations or reconstruction techniques such as meshes, voxels, point clouds, or Gaussian splatting

  • Experience with modern C++ (experience with Rust is also welcome)

Big plus if you’re strong in 3D computer vision. Because our graphics work is tightly coupled with our perception stack, strong vision fundamentals will let you have an even bigger impact:

  • Familiarity with camera models, projective and epipolar geometry, camera calibration, or PnP, which is useful when matching simulated or rendered views directly to real cameras

  • Experience with 3D reconstruction or mapping pipelines such as COLMAP, photogrammetry, Structure-from-Motion (SfM), SLAM, or visual odometry

  • Interest or experience in applying rendering and GPU compute to vision problems like long-range drone detection, satellite-to-camera matching, or depth estimation

General

  • Full-time availability during the internship period.

  • A willingness to pick up and learn new concepts quickly and to self-acquire missing background knowledge.

  • A high degree of autonomy, determination and grit in making cool tech work.

What can we offer

  • 1000 euro monthly compensation.

  • 10 vacation days during internship period.

  • (Really) flexible working hours and option to work from home 2 days per week.

  • Have a direct and significant influence on highly innovative products.

  • The opportunity to iterate quickly with tight feedback loops, close to the product. We are innovating, learning is to be expected.

  • Responsibility over the things you implement, you are the expert on what you build.

The application procedure

  • If after reading the above you are convinced you are the right person for the job, send us some information about yourself; this can be a resume, website or other source, as long as we get a clear impression of your background and skills.

  • We’ll get back to you ASAP. If we feel you could be a fit for the position, we’ll invite you for an informal introduction so we can get to know you, and equally important, you can get to know us. After this, a technical focused interview could follow.

  • If at this point we feel you are the person we are looking for, we’ll discuss the specifics (starting date and period).

  • Welcome to the team!

title: Productmanager - Team Sellers
description:
Onderaannemers ontvangen stapels offerteaanvragen, elk met honderden tekeningen, een bestek en een hoeveelhedenstaat. Veel uitzoekwerk dus, en lang niet elke aanvraag levert uiteindelijk werk op. Dat zien we terug in elk land waar we actief zijn, van Nederland tot Denemarken. Bij 12Build ben jij eigenaar van het product dat daar verandering in brengt.

We zoeken een AI-native productmanager voor Team Sellers, het team dat 12Build bouwt voor onderaannemers en leveranciers. Je hebt een goed gevoel voor product, voelt je thuis in data en werkt al dagelijks met AI-agents. Bovenal ben je graag bij klanten en werk je graag met mensen. Zo doen we productwerk bij 12Build.

Het team en de uitdaging
Team Sellers bestaat uit jou, een productdesigner, een lead developer en developers die samen met agents werken. Jij, de designer en de lead developer sturen het team samen aan als trio. Je bedient twee doelgroepen. Onderaannemers gebruiken 12Build om offerteaanvragen van hoofdaannemers te vinden, te beoordelen en erop te reageren. Leveranciers, de fabrikanten en groothandels in bouwmaterialen, gebruiken het om vroeg in projecten te komen en hun partners te bereiken. Leveranciers zijn een relatief nieuwe doelgroep voor ons, dus er valt nog veel te ontdekken.

Er is genoeg op te lossen. Onderaannemers zijn uren bezig met de vraag welke aanvragen het opstellen van een offerte waard zijn. De informatie die ze nodig hebben, zit verspreid over documenten, e-mails en telefoontjes met de hoofdaannemer. En ze willen zien wat het platform hun oplevert. AI verandert wat we voor onderaannemers en leveranciers kunnen bouwen, en jij bepaalt mee waar het het meeste verschil maakt.

Hoe we werken
12Build werkt sinds 2026 AI-first. Designers, developers en PM’s werken allemaal met agents, en we verbeteren die workflows continu om de weg van klantsignaal naar release korter te maken. Die manier van werken is nog lang niet af, en als PM heb je veel invloed op waar het naartoe gaat.

Een paar voorbeelden van waar we nu staan:

  • Onze bedrijfskennis staat in één gedeelde repository, de brain, waar mensen en agents allebei mee werken.

  • PM’s werken met Claude, gekoppeld aan tools als Amplitude, HubSpot, Linear en Slack.

  • Een wekelijkse signal radar verzamelt klantsignalen uit die bronnen en zet ze om in Linear-issues, met het bewijs erbij.



De PM bepaalt wat we bouwen en waarom. Agents nemen elke maand meer onderzoek, analyse en eerste versies over. De tijd die dat oplevert, gaat naar het werk dat alleen mensen kunnen doen: met klanten praten, relaties opbouwen en iedereen achter één richting krijgen. Samen met de PM’s van Team Buyers en Team Growth bepaal je welke workflow we als volgende verbeteren.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Je bouwt een heldere visie op waar het product voor onderaannemers en leveranciers de komende jaren naartoe gaat, en vertaalt die naar een strategie en roadmap. Die richting stem je af met de andere productteams, Commerce, Sales en Marketing, zodat het platform als geheel werkt.

  • Je bent een groot deel van je week bij onderaannemers en leveranciers en bouwt een netwerk op van klanten die met je meedenken.

  • Je managet je stakeholders. Je houdt het management en de commerciële teams op de hoogte, weegt verzoeken die botsen tegen elkaar af en legt helder uit waarom iets wel of niet op de roadmap staat.

  • Je bepaalt met je trio welke problemen we oplossen en in welke volgorde. Jij bent verantwoordelijk voor waarde en haalbaarheid: gaan klanten het gebruiken en ervoor betalen, en werkt het voor sales, marketing en customer success?

  • Je legt vooraf vast wanneer iets een succes is en meet dat daarna. Onze data-analisten ondersteunen je bij de diepere analyses. Zelf denk je in data: je leest een funnel of een retentiecurve en weet welke vraag je daarna stelt.

  • Samen met de designer werk je toe naar een heldere oplossing. De developers maken er issues van en bouwen het, en jij checkt of wat live gaat het probleem oplost waarmee je begon.

  • Je verbetert hoe het team met agents werkt. Je bouwt en onderhoudt skills, prompts en checks, en deelt wat werkt met de andere teams.

  • Je werkt met Product Marketing en Commerce aan positionering, packaging en lanceringen.


Over 12Build
Al bijna twintig jaar verbindt 12Build hoofdaannemers, onderaannemers en leveranciers. We zijn marktleider in Nederland en actief in België, Duitsland en Denemarken. Sinds januari 2026 zijn we onderdeel van de E1-groep, samen met EstimateOne en C-Link. Ongeveer honderd collega’s werken vanuit twee kantoren en vanuit huis, verspreid over Europa, met een gezonde dosis Drive, Openness en Happiness.

Sven’s tip for new 12Builders:

“Finding your own style and using it to inspire your colleagues is strongly encouraged!”


Werken bij 12Build, durf jij het aan? 


Wat breng je mee?

  • Minimaal vier jaar ervaring in B2B SaaS en een goed gevoel voor product. Dat kan als productmanager, of in een aanverwante rol van waaruit je de stap wilt maken. Eerdere ervaring met een marktplaats of een workflowproduct met veel documenten is een plus.

  • Je hebt eerder een productvisie en -strategie opgesteld en de mensen om je heen erin meegekregen.

  • Je kunt goed met mensen. Je bouwt snel vertrouwen op bij klanten en collega’s, luistert goed en brengt mensen met verschillende belangen samen achter één richting.

  • Technisch begrip. Je hebt nauw samengewerkt met developers, kent de gangbare termen en praat op niveau mee in een discussie met de lead developer.

  • Je denkt in data. Je voelt je thuis in productanalyse (Amplitude of vergelijkbaar), je kunt een experiment opzetten en je weet wanneer een getal te zwak is om een besluit op te baseren.

  • Praktijkervaring met agentic werken. Je gebruikt tools als Claude of Codex voor meer dan chatten, je hebt eigen workflows of skills gebouwd en je kunt ons er een laten zien. Je inspireert collega’s om anders te werken.

  • Je beoordeelt kritisch wat agents opleveren en staat achter wat onder jouw naam live gaat.

  • Je maakt je een nieuw domein snel eigen. Ervaring in de bouw helpt. Nieuwsgierigheid ernaar is een must.

  • Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels.


Wat bieden we?

  • Je kiest je eigen hardware: Windows, Mac of Linux.

  • Je werkt thuis en op kantoor. Voor de thuiswerkdagen krijg je een thuiswerkvergoeding.

  • Elke dag een gratis lunch op kantoor.

  • Een cultuur waar we echt in investeren, met teamdagen, uitjes, sprekers en workshops.

  • Een platte organisatie met korte lijnen.

Heb je nog vragen of twijfel je nog een beetje? Geen probleem! Stuur gerust een e-mail naar Niels (Recruiter, Instagram of               

Tot snel!

title: Senior Manager, Capability Engineering & Customer Training, EMEA

description:
Account Executive, Payments (Existing Merchants)

 

Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋

Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might be in the right place!

 

We are looking for an Account Executive, Payments, who is responsible for driving the adoption of Lightspeed Payments within Lightspeed's existing merchant base in the Netherlands. This is a dedicated cross-sell/upsell position focused on transitioning current Point of Sale (POS) customers to our proprietary, integrated payment processing solution.

Lightspeed Payments has been continually invested into since launch in 2019, integrating a number of unique value drivers into the combined POS-payments solution. Building off of success our new business teams have experienced in selling the combined POS-payments solution, we are scaling our ability to sell payments into our existing merchant base, many of which became clients before we scaled Lightspeed Payments.

 

This position reports to the Global Payments Sales Manager and is part of the Global Payments GTM team.

 

Your Mission

The primary responsibility is to meet and exceed sales targets for Lightspeed Payments adoption among existing merchants.

  • Pipeline Management: Generate and manage sales opportunities using leads sourced from Account Managers, direct phone/email outreach, and follow-up on company-led marketing campaigns.

  • Sales Execution: Manage the complete sales cycle from initial qualification and value presentation through pricing negotiation and contract closure.

  • Customer Launch: Partner with Onboarding teams to ensure a smooth transition and launch for merchants adopting Lightspeed Payments.

  • Internal Expertise: Serve as the internal Subject Matter Expert (SME) on payment processing for other units, providing guidance and training as required.

  • Product Feedback: Collect and relay merchant feedback regarding the payments product to the Product Management teams.

  • Reporting: Maintain accurate records of all sales activities, pipeline status, and opportunity notes in Salesforce

  • Other Duties: Handle additional duties and responsibilities as defined by management.

     

What you’ll be bringing to the team

  • Payments Experience: Direct experience (3+ years) in the payment processing industry.

  • Sales Closing Role: Demonstrated experience (3+ years) in a closing role focused on technology or solution sales.

  • Opportunity Development: Proven ability to proactively generate and qualify new opportunities.

  • Target Achievement: Documented history of success in a revenue target or quota-based environment.

  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Dutch language skills are a requirement.

 

What’s in it for you?

  • Genuine career growth opportunities based on performance within a company that's continuously expanding

  • Work with highly skilled people who are as passionate about sales & marketing as you are

  • An environment that encourages initiatives and leadership

  • Work in a team big enough for growth but lean enough to make a real impact

  • Fun activities with your teammates & social events throughout the year

  • Opportunity to learn, expand your skill set, forge wonderful relationships and make your mark within the diverse and inclusive Lightspeed culture, a true Canadian tech success story

... and further

  • Lightspeed equity scheme (we are all owners)

  • Health & Wellness Credit- expense up to 400 EUR per year towards your gym membership, yoga classes, a new bike or whatever else you do for your health

  • Mental Health Support through the Modern Health App- whether it is meditation, coaching or counseling you need - each employee gets access to this platform

  • People Experience - Our PX benefit allows you to work from pretty much anywhere in the world for 60 days a year

  • Time off to volunteer and give back to your community

  • Healthy snacks and after work organized by the company

 
 

To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Where to from here?

Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here.

Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs.

Who we are:

Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks.

Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries.

Lightspeed handles your information in accordance with our Applicant Privacy Statement.

description:
Marketing & AI Intern

title: QA Engineer (EN)
description:
About the role

At YoungOnes, you make sure our platform delivers on its promise: stable, reliable and free of surprises for the people who use it every day. As a QA Engineer you don't work at the end of the chain, but right in the middle of our development teams. You think along before any code is written, test smartly where it matters, and act as the bridge between development, product and the rest of the company when it comes to quality. You report to the Teamlead Frontend and work daily with the frontend, mobile and backend teams.

What you'll do

  • Think along from the start. You join refinements and help teams see the risks and impact of a feature before they start building;

  • Choose the right test approach. Together with the team, you decide per feature what to test automatically, what to test manually, and why;

  • Build and maintain automated tests. You set up tests for key platform functionality and keep them reliable;

  • Manual and exploratory testing. You go through the app yourself, look for edge cases and find what a script misses;

  • Central point of contact for bugs. Bug reports from across the company come to you. You reproduce them, gather all the information a developer needs to get started, and get them ready in Jira with the right priority;

  • Advise on releases. You map out risks and give clear advice on the quality of a release;

  • Provide insight. You collect test data and show how our software quality is doing;

  • Keep the balance. You help teams weigh fixing bugs against building new features.

What you bring

  • A bachelor's level of working and thinking, preferably in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field;

  • At least 2 years of work experience, including at least 1 year as a QA Engineer, Software Tester or Test Automation Engineer;

  • Experience setting up and carrying out a test approach and test plans;

  • Experience with test automation and test frameworks;

  • You're comfortable working with AI tools and use them purposefully: to test faster and better, and to set up automated tests;

  • Experience working in an Agile/Scrum team and with a bug tracking system, preferably Jira.

  • You work independently, make decisions in your own work and give advice, whether asked or not;

  • You're critical and analytical, take initiative and work well with developers, product and business.

Nice to have

  • Knowledge of TypeScript/JavaScript and you're comfortable working with code;

  • You look beyond "does it work?": also at accessibility, speed, security and multilingual support.

  • Experience with tests that run automatically on every code change, and you know how to deal with unreliable tests;

  • You enjoy sharing knowledge and helping colleagues test better;

  • Experience testing mobile apps.

We're looking for someone who sees quality as something the whole team owns. You don't just perfect your own testing work; you ask yourself what needs to change structurally so the whole team tests better. Our own values guide the way: Own it, Say it, Make it.

What we offer

  • A gross salary between €3,400 and €4,800 based on full-time employment;

  • 25 vacation days, 6.5 ADV days and 1 additional holiday per calendar year, based on a 40-hour workweek;

  • 8% vacation pay, a pension plan, and (if you live more than 10 km from the office) a travel allowance;

  • We prioritize mental well-being in collaboration with our partner OpenUp;

  • Great perks such as: a yearly fitness budget, a freshly prepared healthy lunch every day, snacks, bi-weekly afternoon drinks, XL borrels every three months and much more;

Dit betreft een full time functie, met veel afwisseling en hulp van betrokken teamgenoten om de meest slimme/ efficiënte besturingsoplossingen te bouwen.

Ontwerp en programmeer jij graag de nieuwste deegverwerkingsmachines van AMF Bakery Systems? Step dan in als Senior Controls Engineer! Heb je ervaring als software, controls of mechatronica engineer in machinebouw, ben je vertrouwd met programmeren in structured text en ben je bekend met Siemens besturingstechniek? Hecht je aan betrokken en slimme collega's waarmee je samen 'state of the art' voedselproductielijnen ontwerpt, programmeert en bouwt? Super, dan zijn we op zoek naar jou!

  • Reiskostenvergoeding (€0,25 / km); vitaliteitsbudget tot €25,00 netto per maand en een zeer goede pensioenvoorziening (PME)

  • Werken in een enthousiast en innoverend team

  • Informele werksfeer, teamuitjes, vrijdagmiddagborrel

title: Digital Channel Manager (Kiosk)
description:
Wil jij werken voor een fantastisch merk waar je direct impact kunt maken? Ben jij een digital marketing professional met een passie voor food en retail, en voel jij je thuis in een internationale omgeving? Dan is dit jouw kans.

Wat is jouw bijdrage aan het succes van KFC?
Jij bent verantwoordelijk voor het commerciële succes en de continue optimalisatie van het kiosk-kanaal van KFC Nederland. Met behulp van data-analyse, klantinzichten en nauwe samenwerking met verschillende teams zorg je voor meer gebruik van de kiosken, hogere omzet, betere conversie en een hogere gemiddelde besteding per gast.

Jouw volgende uitdaging begint hier

Als Digital Channel Manager (Kiosk) maak je deel uit van het Digital Team van KFC en speel je een belangrijke rol in onze digitale toekomst. Jij bent de drijvende kracht achter de commerciële prestaties en voortdurende optimalisatie van onze self-service kiosken in de restaurants.

Je pakt nieuwe zaken snel op, bent nieuwsgierig van aard en weet klant- en prestatiegegevens moeiteloos te vertalen naar heldere acties en verbeteringen.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Je bent eigenaar van één van KFC's belangrijkste digitale verkoopkanalen en hét aanspreekpunt voor alles rondom de kiosken. Je monitort en verbetert het gebruik, de omzet, conversie en de gemiddelde besteding per gast.

  • Je creëert een eenvoudige, snelle en intuïtieve klantreis, terwijl je tegelijkertijd zorgt voor gebruiksgemak voor onze restaurantteams.

  • Je stelt business requirements op, coördineert testtrajecten en ondersteunt de implementatie van verbeteringen aan de kiosken in samenwerking met het regionale productteam, IT, Operations en technologiepartners.

  • Je signaleert kansen om prestaties te verbeteren door dashboards te monitoren en nauw samen te werken met Commercial Finance. Inzichten vertaal je naar concrete acties.

  • Je verhoogt de conversie door middel van A/B-testen, analyses van klantgedrag en continue optimalisatie van de kiosk-ervaring en productpresentatie.

  • Je zorgt ervoor dat campagnes, producten en waardeproposities effectief worden gepresenteerd en correct worden gelanceerd op de kiosken. Daarbij optimaliseer je de menustructuur, productzichtbaarheid en upsell- en cross-sellmogelijkheden.

  • Je houdt platformproblemen in de gaten en werkt samen met IT en technologiepartners om deze op te lossen.

  • Je werkt intensief samen met Operations om het gebruik van de kiosken en de uitvoering in de restaurants te verbeteren. Daarnaast werk je nauw samen met collega's van Digital, Brand, Innovation, IT, Commercial en externe partners.

Over KFC Nederland

Kentucky Fried Chicken, de Amerikaanse restaurantketen gespecialiseerd in fried chicken, is sinds 1972 actief in Nederland. Inmiddels telt Nederland 96 KFC-restaurants. Dagelijks bereiden onze chefs verse kip- en vegetarische gerechten volgens het originele recept uit 1939 van oprichter Colonel Harland Sanders. Naast de focus op onze producten en de verdere groei van ons restaurantnetwerk, investeren we volop in de ontwikkeling van onze medewerkers.


Wat breng jij mee?

  • Sterke analytische vaardigheden en ervaring met het monitoren van dashboards, het vertalen van data naar inzichten en acties, en het uitvoeren van A/B-testen.

  • Ervaring met het verbeteren van klantreizen, digitale interfaces en online merchandising.

  • Sterke projectmanagement- en stakeholdermanagementvaardigheden, met het vermogen om mensen te beïnvloeden zonder hiërarchische verantwoordelijkheid.

  • Een gestructureerde, proactieve en hands-on werkstijl, gecombineerd met een pragmatische en samenwerkingsgerichte aanpak.

  • Nieuwsgierigheid en de drive om continu te testen, leren en verbeteren.

  • Uitstekende beheersing van zowel de Nederlandse als Engelse taal, mondeling en schriftelijk.

Voldoe je niet aan alle eisen? Geen probleem!

Onderzoek laat zien dat mensen vaak pas solliciteren wanneer zij aan vrijwel alle functie-eisen voldoen. Bij Collins Foods kijken we niet alleen naar ervaring, maar ook naar potentieel en ambitie.

Bij ons krijg je de kans om echt impact te maken binnen een internationale, dynamische en groeiende organisatie. Je komt terecht in een hecht team waar initiatief, ondernemerschap en creativiteit worden gewaardeerd én verwacht.

Daarnaast kun je rekenen op:

  • Veel vrijheid om je rol vorm te geven en jouw ideeën werkelijkheid te maken.
